_handoff.scopeNote: Official-source pass for Bengaluru birth registration, certificate copies, child-name inclusion, correction, delayed registration, and authenticity. Primary statutes and official Karnataka/BBMP pages were used. No login, OTP, personal identifier, document upload, payment, form submission, or case lookup was attempted. Legacy, rural-only, undated, and report-based material is explicitly caveated.

documentationShelf.title: Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1969 — India Code
documentationShelf.whatItCovers: Sections 8, 12, 13, 14, 15, and 17: reporting responsibility, certificate, delayed registration, child name, correction/cancellation, and register search/electronic certificate access.
documentationShelf.whereItStops: No current BBMP counter, portal fields, fee, document checklist, or case outcome.

documentationShelf.title: Model Registration of Births and Deaths Rules, 1999 — India Code
documentationShelf.whatItCovers: Model reporting forms, 21-day reporting period, Form 5/6 certificate extracts, and historical search/extract/non-availability fee examples.
documentationShelf.whereItStops: Model rules are not asserted as a current Karnataka fee schedule or complete BBMP operating instruction.

documentationShelf.title: BBMP Citizen Services — Birth & Death Certificate
documentationShelf.whatItCovers: Official citizen-services index lists Online Birth Certificate Request Form and Authenticity Of Certificates.
documentationShelf.whereItStops: Index only; live target, fields, eligibility, fees, and status behavior were not verified.

documentationShelf.title: Greater Bengaluru Authority public home / e-Services
documentationShelf.whatItCovers: Current public GBA page lists Birth & Death Certificate among e-Services.
documentationShelf.whereItStops: No birth form, record lookup, correction rules, or case-specific status.

documentationShelf.title: Birth Certificate — District Bengaluru Urban
documentationShelf.whatItCovers: The page says its eJanMa instructions concern rural Karnataka and gives rural name-inclusion/copy/correction directions.
documentationShelf.whereItStops: Must not be used as proof that a BBMP municipal event follows a Nada Kacheri route.

documentationShelf.title: BBMP Administrative Reforms — Issue of Birth, Still Birth and Death Certificates
documentationShelf.whatItCovers: 2023 BBMP process-audit section records described designated officers, reported Sakala timing, SMS rejection, and missing status tracking.
documentationShelf.whereItStops: A report observation, not a current citizen charter or service guarantee.

documentationShelf.title: BBMP IT Department — About Us
documentationShelf.whatItCovers: Legacy description of web, mobile, IVRS, and Bangalore One/citizen-service-centre delivery channels.
documentationShelf.whereItStops: Undated; current availability and per-channel routing are unknown.

claims.text: Section 8 of the Registration of Births and Deaths Act assigns reporting responsibility according to the place and circumstances of the event, including the medical officer or authorised person for an institutional birth and the head of the house or household for a domiciliary birth.
claims.notes: Statutory allocation; not a current BBMP counter or portal instruction.

claims.text: Section 12 provides for a certificate of registration, and section 17 allows a person, subject to state rules and fees, to request a register search and obtain a birth certificate electronically or otherwise.
claims.notes: Legal framework; delivery channel and fee remain implementation-dependent.

claims.text: Section 13 distinguishes late information within thirty days, after thirty days but within one year, and after one year; the latter two categories require additional permission or order and prescribed fee under the Act and applicable rules.
claims.notes: The section does not identify the current Karnataka officer, form, fee, or evidence checklist.

claims.text: Section 14 provides that when a birth was registered without a child's name, the parent or guardian gives the name to the Registrar orally or in writing within the prescribed period, after which the Registrar enters and initials/dates it.
claims.notes: The current BBMP form, fee, supporting documents, and online availability are not established.

claims.text: Section 15 permits the Registrar, on satisfaction that an entry is erroneous in form or substance or was fraudulently/improperly made, to correct or cancel it by a marginal entry without altering the original entry, with signature and date.
claims.notes: Statutory correction mechanism; present BBMP evidence threshold is not established.

claims.text: Section 17 states that, subject to state rules on fees and postal charges, any person may cause a register search and obtain a birth certificate electronically or otherwise; the certificate is certified by the Registrar or authorised officer.
claims.notes: Does not prove every historical BBMP record is searchable online.

claims.text: Rule 5 of the official Model Registration of Births and Deaths Rules says prescribed-form information is to be given within twenty-one days from the birth, death, or still birth.
claims.notes: Model rules are not asserted here as a complete current Karnataka rulebook.

claims.text: The BBMP Citizen Services page lists Online Birth Certificate Request Form and Authenticity Of Certificates under the Birth & Death Certificate service group.
claims.notes: Official service index; live form target, fields, validation, payment, and status were not observed.

claims.text: The current Greater Bengaluru Authority public home lists Birth & Death Certificate among its e-Services.

The Bengaluru Urban District Birth Certificate page says its eJanMa description covers births, deaths, and still births electronically registered in Rural Karnataka and directs rural name inclusion, additional copies, and corrections to rural registration personnel.
claims.notes: Do not infer a Nada Kacheri route for a BBMP municipal event.

claims.text: A BBMP administrative-reforms report describes the Medical Officer/Deputy MO/Superintendent in large hospitals and Assistant Statistical Officer as designated officers in the reviewed process, and reports a Sakala limit of three days where online data is available and seven days where it is not.
claims.notes: 2023 report observation, not a current service-level promise; report also records no status tracking.

claims.text: BBMP's IT Department description says birth/death registration was delivered through web, mobile, IVRS, and citizen service centres such as Bangalore One.
claims.notes: Legacy/undated channel description; current availability is unknown.

claims.text: No official public source reviewed establishes whether a particular Bengaluru birth record exists, which Registrar or office owns it, what documents or fee a particular correction/name-inclusion case needs, whether an online request is accepted, or whether a certificate has issued.
claims.notes: No login, identifier lookup, upload, payment, submission, or case-status request was performed.

edges.label: Event location determines the relevant registration authority and register to search; the rural district page must not be substituted for BBMP municipal routing.
A found/registered entry supports certificate access under sections 12 and 17; current delivery route was not tested.
Statutory name entry can precede a certificate reflecting the entered name; no current BBMP transition was observed.
A Registrar correction/cancellation decision can change the register and subsequent certificate; acceptance and issuance were not observed.
Late-registration authority and evidence may be needed before a searchable entry/certificate exists; case path is unknown.
BBMP public index exposes an authenticity link, but the target and verification result were not tested.

roadblocks.title: Rural eJanMa guidance may be mistaken for BBMP procedure
roadblocks.symptom: A Bengaluru Urban page describes rural Nada Kacheri/eJanMa handling while the requester needs a BBMP municipal route.
roadblocks.likelyCause: The district page is rural-focused and the event's place-of-occurrence authority was not established.
roadblocks.recovery: Confirm place of birth and responsible Registrar before using a form, office, fee, or document checklist. Do not infer BBMP procedure from the rural page.

roadblocks.title: Public index does not expose the live case route
roadblocks.symptom: BBMP lists an online request and authenticity service, but the live target, fields, login requirement, fee, and status behavior were not visible in this pass.
roadblocks.likelyCause: The citizen-services page is an index and no identifier or form session was used.
roadblocks.recovery: Use the official BBMP/GBA entry and confirm the live target and responsible Registrar before entering personal data; preserve any later acknowledgement.

roadblocks.title: Historical timing may be mistaken for a guarantee
roadblocks.symptom: A BBMP reform report records three/seven-day Sakala timing, while public pages do not provide a current case timer.
roadblocks.likelyCause: The report is a 2023 audit/recommendation document and not a current citizen charter.
roadblocks.recovery: Treat timing as a reported process observation only; seek the current acknowledgement/service standard for the specific request.
